definitions.explanation: A cream applied to the skin to chemically dissolve and remove body hair. Applied, left for a few minutes, then wiped off along with the hair. Used as an alternative to shaving or waxing.

examples.japanese: {除毛|じょもう}クリーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処理|しょり}した→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧。
examples.english: I removed the hair on my legs with depilatory cream.
Hair removal cream may not be suitable for people with sensitive skin.

examples.japanese: {除毛|じょもう}クリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧パッチ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
